data.name: Ermengarde
data.gender_notes: Ermengarde is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Germanic elements ermen, meaning 'earth' or 'whole' and gard, meaning 'spear'. This name was popular among European royalty and means 'strong, noble spear' or 'whole, brave' in origin. The name Ermengarde carries the meaning “Strong, noble spear” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ermengarde usually hope their child will grow to embody strong, noble spear and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name of strength and courage, reminding us of the power of the divine within.
data.etymology: Ermengarde belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong, noble spear.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ermengarde total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
